각인 영단어장

보기 → 떠올리기 → 퀴즈
📱 학습 화면(보기 → 떠올리기 → 퀴즈)이 안 나오고 이 목록만 보이면, 파일을 미리보기로 연 상태예요. 크롬 · 사파리 · 삼성 인터넷 같은 브라우저로 열면 학습 화면이 나와요. 이 목록은 그대로 단어장으로 써도 돼요.

L5 단어

Lesson 5 · Think like Sherlock Holmes! · 33개
throw던지다💭 '쓰~로우' 쓰레기를 휙 던지다 (threw-thrown)Someone threw a cake at the painting.
museum박물관, 미술관💭 예술의 여신 '뮤즈'가 사는 집 = 뮤지엄the Botero Museum
eyewitness목격자💭 eye(눈) + witness(증인) = 눈으로 본 증인There were four eyewitnesses.
criminal범인, 범죄자💭 '크리미널' 크림 케이크를 던진 범인!Read the following, and find the criminal.
suspect용의자💭 '서스펙트' 수상해서 쳐다보게 되는 사람Look at the information about the suspects.
visitor방문객💭 visit(방문하다) + or(사람)Ann Jones, a visitor
painting그림💭 paint(칠하다) + ing = 칠해 놓은 그림pieces of cake all over the painting
wheelchair휠체어💭 wheel(바퀴) + chair(의자)He was standing in front of a wheelchair.
janitor청소부, 건물 관리인💭 '재니터' 쟤 니 터(자리)까지 청소해 주는 사람Carlos Diaz, a janitor
gray회색의💭 회색 코끼리 = 그레이an old man with gray hair
wig가발💭 '위그' 머리 위에 그냥 얹는 가발It was his wig.
catch잡다💭 캐치볼 = 공을 잡다 (caught-caught)I couldn't catch him.
guard경비원💭 보디가드 = 지키는 사람Diego Perez, a guard
crime범죄💭 '크라임' 크~ 나쁜 짓 = 범죄I went to the crime scene.
scene현장, 장면💭 드라마 명장면 = 명씬(scene)the crime scene
piece조각💭 퍼즐 피스 한 조각pieces of cake
bakery빵집, 제과점💭 bake(굽다) + ry(곳) = 빵 굽는 곳The box was from Camila's Bakery.
owner주인💭 own(소유하다) + er(사람)the owner of Camila's Bakery
understand이해하다💭 under(아래) + stand(서다) = 밑바닥까지 알다 (understood)He didn't understand me.
different다른, 다양한💭 differ(다르다) → '디퍼런트' 다 달라!a lot of different cakes
remember기억하다💭 re(다시) + member(멤버) 얼굴을 다시 떠올리다I remember him clearly.
clearly분명히, 또렷하게💭 clear(맑은) + ly = 맑게, 또렷하게I remember him clearly.
height키, 높이💭 high(높은)의 명사 = 하이트Height: 176 cm
language언어💭 '랭귀지' 혀(lingua)로 하는 말Languages: Spanish, English
Spanish스페인어💭 Spain(스페인) + ish(~의 말)I spoke to him in Spanish.
steal훔치다💭 '스틸' 슬~쩍 훔치다 (stole-stolen)Someone stole the gold rings.
damage손상시키다💭 게임에서 '데미지'를 입히다Man Damages Monalisa
missing실종된, 없어진💭 miss(놓치다) → 놓쳐서 없어진Famous Painter Botero Missing
rule규칙💭 게임 룰(rule) = 규칙Make class rules.
feed먹이를 주다💭 '피드' 동물아, 피~드세요!You must not feed the animals.
flash(카메라) 플래시💭 번쩍! 카메라 플래시You must not use the flash.
drone드론💭 윙윙 하늘을 나는 드론You must not fly a drone here.
secret code암호💭 secret(비밀) + code(부호)Make a new secret code.

L5 숙어·표현

Lesson 5 · Think like Sherlock Holmes! · 15개
throw A at BB에 A를 던지다💭 at = 과녁을 향해 던지다threw a cake at the Monalisa
turn around뒤돌아보다💭 turn(돌다) + around(빙) = 휙 돌아보다I turned around and saw an old man.
in front of~앞에💭 front(앞) = 프런트 데스크는 앞쪽in front of a wheelchair
a little taller조금 더 큰 (a little + 비교급)💭 a little = 조금, taller = 더 큰He was a little taller than me.
run away도망치다💭 run(달리다) + away(멀리)An old man was running away.
fall off~에서 떨어지다💭 fall(떨어지다) + off(떨어져 나감)Something fell off his head.
run after~을 뒤쫓다💭 after(뒤) = 뒤를 따라 달리다I ran after him.
in fact사실은💭 fact(사실) 속을 보면 = 사실은In fact, the old man was not old.
all over~곳곳에, 온통💭 all(전부) + over(위) = 온통pieces of cake all over the painting
next to~옆에💭 next(바로 다음) = 바로 옆next to the wheelchair
come in들어오다💭 in(안으로) + come(오다)A young man came in.
speak to A in SpanishA에게 스페인어로 말하다💭 in + 언어 = ~어로I spoke to him in Spanish.
a lot of많은💭 lot(무더기) = 한 무더기의a lot of different cakes
May I ~?~해도 될까요?💭 May I? = 공손하게 허락 구하기May I drink water in class?
must not~하면 안 된다💭 must(반드시) + not = 절대 안 돼You must not eat snacks in class.

L6 단어

Lesson 6 · Good for the Earth, Good for Us · 51개
zero0, 영💭 제로 콜라 = 설탕 0zero-waste challenge
waste쓰레기, 낭비💭 '웨이스트' 웨~ 이 쓰레기 좀 봐!Every day, we produce lots of waste.
challenge도전💭 SNS 챌린지 = 도전Join the zero-waste challenge.
produce생산하다, 만들어 내다💭 프로듀서 = 만들어 내는 사람We produce lots of waste.
sick아픈💭 씩씩하지 못하고 '씩' 아픈 (sicker and sicker)The Earth is getting sicker and sicker.
save구하다, 아끼다💭 게임 세이브 = 지켜서 구하다Do you want to save the Earth?
join참여하다, 가입하다💭 조인 = 함께 끼어들다Join the challenge.
share나누다, 공유하다💭 셰어하우스 = 나눠 쓰는 집Share your stories.
reduce줄이다💭 re(뒤로) + duce(끌다) = 줄이다Reduce Food Waste
leftover남은 음식💭 left(남은) + over(넘친) 음식There were lots of leftovers.
FYI참고로💭 For Your Information = 참고로FYI, you can find great cooking ideas.
idea생각, 아이디어💭 번쩍! 아이디어great cooking ideas for leftovers
reuse재사용하다💭 re(다시) + use(쓰다)I decided to fix it and reuse it.
tear찢다💭 '테어' 테이프를 찌~익 찢다 (tore-torn)My dog tore my bag.
learn배우다, 알게 되다💭 배우러 '런'(run)!I learned that reusing is important.
important중요한💭 '임포턴트' 임무처럼 꼭 중요한Reusing is important for zero-waste living.
living생활💭 live(살다) + ing = 사는 것, 생활zero-waste living
decide결심하다, 결정하다💭 '디사이드' 이 사이드(쪽)로 결정!I decided to fix it.
fix고치다💭 픽스 = 단단히 고정해서 고치다I decided to fix it and reuse it.
sew바느질하다💭 발음 '소우' — 소매를 꿰매다I'm not very good at sewing.
perfect완벽한💭 퍼펙트 게임 = 완벽The bag doesn't look perfect.
guess추측하다, ~인 것 같다💭 '게스' 게 뭘까? 추측해 봐I guess it's all right.
single-use일회용의💭 single(하나) + use(사용) = 한 번 쓰는Say No to Single-Use Plastic
plastic플라스틱💭 플라스틱 통Plastic never goes away completely.
often자주💭 가게 문이 자주 '오픈' = oftenI often use food delivery services.
delivery배달💭 딜리버리 = 배달 오토바이food delivery services
service서비스💭 서비스 = 도와주는 일food delivery services
instead대신에💭 in + stead(자리) = 그 자리에 대신Instead, I walked to my favorite restaurant.
favorite가장 좋아하는💭 favor(좋아함) → 제일 좋아하는my favorite restaurant
reusable재사용할 수 있는, 다회용의💭 reuse + able(할 수 있는)a reusable container
container용기, 그릇💭 contain(담다) + er = 담는 것a reusable container
completely완전히💭 complete(완성된) + ly = 완전히Plastic never goes away completely.
recycle재활용하다💭 re(다시) + cycle(순환)Recycle plastic and glass bottles.
glass유리, 유리잔💭 글라스 = 유리컵glass bottles
bottle병💭 보틀 = 물병plastic and glass bottles
machine기계💭 머신 = 기계a recycling machine
point포인트, 점수💭 포인트 적립!I got some points in return.
cool멋진, 시원한💭 쿨하다 = 멋지다Don't you think that's cool?
trash쓰레기💭 '트래시' 툭 버린 쓰레기pick up trash
label라벨, 상표💭 병에 붙은 라벨I took all the labels off the bottles.
environment환경💭 environ(둘러싸다) = 우리를 둘러싼 환경Environment Day
size크기💭 사이즈 = 크기The size is 250 mm.
color색💭 컬러 = 색The color is red.
favor부탁, 호의💭 Do me a favor! = 부탁 하나 들어줘I need a favor.
secondhand중고의💭 second(두 번째) + hand(손) = 두 번째 주인I often buy things from secondhand stores.
shower샤워💭 짧게 샤워하기I usually take short showers.
own자신의💭 my own cup = 나만의 컵I usually carry my own cup.
plog플로깅하다 (조깅하며 쓰레기 줍기)💭 pick up + jog = 플로깅We're going to plog together.
empty비우다, 빈💭 MT 가면 방이 텅 '엠티'empty the trash can
healthy건강한💭 health(건강) + yDo you want to be healthy?
salt소금💭 솔트 = 소금Reduce salt in your food.

L6 숙어·표현

Lesson 6 · Good for the Earth, Good for Us · 24개
eat out외식하다💭 out(밖에서) + eat(먹다)My family and I ate out.
bring A homeA를 집에 가져오다💭 bring(가져오다, brought) + homeWe brought them home.
make A out of BB로 A를 만들다💭 out of = ~에서 꺼내 만들다I made a nice lunch out of them.
think again다시 생각하다💭 think(생각하다) + again(다시)I thought again.
be important for~에 중요하다💭 for(~에게) 중요하다Reusing is important for zero-waste living.
be good at~을 잘하다💭 at 그 분야에서 goodI'm not very good at sewing.
look perfect완벽해 보이다 (look + 형용사)💭 look + 형용사 = ~해 보이다The bag doesn't look perfect.
all right괜찮은💭 all(전부) right(맞아) = 괜찮아I guess it's all right.
say no to~을 거절하다💭 no라고 말하다 = 거절Say no to single-use plastic.
pick up가지러 가다, 줍다💭 pick(집다) + up(위로)I picked up the food.
go away사라지다💭 go(가다) + away(멀리) = 사라지다Plastic never goes away completely.
not ~ any전혀 ~않다💭 not + any = 하나도 없다I didn't use any single-use plastic.
take A to BA를 B로 가져가다💭 take(가져가다, took) + to(~로)I took some bottles to a machine.
put A into BA를 B에 넣다💭 into(안으로) 넣다I put them into the machine.
one by one하나씩💭 하나 다음 또 하나I put them in one by one.
in return그 대가로💭 return(돌려주다) = 돌려받는 것I got some points in return.
like money돈처럼💭 like(~처럼) + moneyI can use them like money.
sicker and sicker점점 더 아픈 (비교급 and 비교급)💭 비교급 and 비교급 = 점점 더The Earth is getting sicker and sicker.
Don't you think ~?~라고 생각하지 않니?💭 부정의문문 = 동의를 구하는 말Don't you think that's cool?
give away(무료로) 나눠 주다💭 give(주다) + away(멀리) = 내 손을 떠나게I want to give away my sneakers.
I'd love to, but ~그러고 싶지만 ~💭 거절 + 이유 말하기I'd love to, but I can't. I'm busy now.
Can you please ~?~해 줄 수 있니?💭 please = 공손한 부탁Can you please fix my bike?
help A with BA가 B하는 것을 돕다💭 with = ~에 관해 돕다Can you help me with my homework?
I need a favor.부탁이 있어.💭 favor = 부탁I need a favor. Can you please water the plants?
